column1: # What each section of tools/tests/selftest.sh costs: its name as its
# "# ---- name" line spells it, a tab, and the seconds its arms took. The
# shards are dealt by these (selftest.sh, "SHARD WEIGHTS"), so what counts
# is how the sections compare, not the seconds themselves, which are a
# Measured: each section's share of all the arms' seconds, averaged over
# five runs of both targets, one on an idle machine at 6e639729 and four
# at load 16-200 on 2026-10-16, then scaled to the idle run's seconds; a
# section whose arms changed is averaged over the runs made since. A run's
# seconds for a section are the mean of its "[section NAME: Ns, its arms]"
# lines in :selftest's and :selftest_bash's eight shard logs (a name that
# heads several sections sums them all): the two shells rank the sections
# alike, so one table deals both.
# `bazel run //tools/tests:selftest_costs` says which rows have drifted, and
# logs, on this table's scale (selftest_costs.sh says how). The deal reads
# only these rows, so it cannot see a listed section that grew: nothing but
# a run read back against them can (TO VERIFY V285).
# A section in a block the template build strips has its row in such a
# block here too; selftest.sh refuses the table otherwise, and a row that
# names a section the file does not have.
